'''God-King''' was a religious title.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> The [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as [[Malevolence (cult)|the Malevolence]] came to revere [[Darth Andeddu]] as their "God-King."<ref name="DOE" /> The [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] revered [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] as their "God-Kings" and built temples in their honor.<ref name="SoR" />
